name: Architecture Clarity
description: The tool's NKP data accurately reflects the system's stress surface and residual architecture
positive_state: Stressors, purposes, attractors, and residues form a coherent ledger; matrix columns and verify links agree with the fully-qualified component registry
negative_state: NKP columns orphan against obsolete tokens; Ri stays empty or contradictory; operators cannot trust the recorded stress surface

name: Terminology Drift
description: Domain terms accumulate without definitions or become inconsistent across files
positive_state: Lexicon aliases cover plural hyphen and phrase forms; outcome validation hits defined terms without false rejects
negative_state: Outcomes fail validation; lexicon grows stale; operator sessions invent contradictory terms

name: Skill Staleness
description: Installed skill files diverge from embedded skill definitions in the binary
positive_state: Installed stubs match embedded skill versions or delegate content to the binary; skill-check stays green
negative_state: Operators work from outdated methodology; skill-check reports version mismatch

name: Data Fragmentation
description: residual/ files become inconsistent — stressors reference nonexistent attractors; traits have no terminology basis
positive_state: Forces, residues, sessions, and format migration keep residual/ consistent under concurrent and migrated writes
negative_state: verify all returns violations; change-detection is ignored; no trustworthy baseline for FMEA or ATAM

name: Residuals Incongruence
description: The residual/ data diverges from the actual project state — stressors reference obsolete components, traits fail validation silently, and skill sessions produce analysis grounded in fabricated architecture
positive_state: residual/ mirrors the proposed architecture_set; residues resolve to registry names; tag-scan suggestions align with verification
negative_state: Obsolete component tokens remain; skill-data surfaces stale or empty metadata; analysis is grounded in fabricated architecture

name: Fluent Architecture Capture
description: Metadata additions land in the right place regardless of session phase or explicit skill invocation — the tool meets the operator where they are, minimizing cognitive overhead of maintaining accurate residuals data
positive_state: Stressors and purposes land mid-session without phase ceremony; a-la-carte skills remain usable; verify enforces structure not order
negative_state: Operators over-gate phases or abandon the tool as too rigid

name: Software-Only Tunnel Vision
description: Residues are assumed to be code changes; stressors better answered by hardware, process, or policy zig are forced into brittle software zags
positive_state: Operator examines whole-system-residue before recording a software-only naive change
negative_state: Stressors are forced into brittle software zags when hardware, process, organization, or policy would survive better
